notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
